401-3944-6094-8125.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
Your life total is at least 2.
401-3944-6094-8125.description:
Cast Blood Pet by paying {B}.
When Blood Pet enters the battlefield, Davvol triggers, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Blood Pet dies, Decaying Soil and Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger.
Resolve the Decaying Soil trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return Blood Pet from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Repeat.

2792-7546-8208.easyPrerequisites:
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{R}.
Inspired Skypainter is prepared.
2792-7546-8208.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Maestro's Gift by paying {3}{U}{R}, targeting Great Whale.
Codie triggers, copying Maestro's Gift, targeting Inspired Skypainter.
Resolve the copy of Maestro's Gift, creating a token copy of Inspired Skypainter with haste
When the Inspired Skypainter token enters, it triggers, causing it to become prepared.
Resolve the original Maestro's Gift, creating a token copy of Great Whale with haste
When the Great Whale token enters, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with six or more +1/+1 counters on it

645-2060-3750-3899-6835.notablePrerequisites: Alesha cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
645-2060-3750-3899-6835.description:
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Arcbound Overseer.
When Arcbound Overseer dies, it triggers, putting its +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability five times by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Declare Alesha as an attacker, triggering its ability, targeting Arcbound Overseer.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W/B}{W/B}.
Resolve the Alesha trigger, causing you to pay {W/B}{W/B} to return Arcbound Overseer from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking with six +1/+1 counters on it due to its modular ability.
Repeat.

4275-5003-7892-8095.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four other Elves that do not have summoning sickness.
4275-5003-7892-8095.description:
Activate at least four Elves other than Thranduil by tapping them, adding at least four in any combination of {G} and/or {U}.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Thranduil.
When Thranduil dies, Nim Deathmantle and Faces of the Past trigger.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Thranduil from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Faces of the Past trigger, untapping all Elves and Nobles.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

1703-4984-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Academy Researchers
When Academy Researchers dies, Fool's Demise first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the second Fool's Demise trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the first Fool's Demise trigger, returning Academy Researchers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Academy Researchers enters, it triggers, putting Fool's Demise onto the battlefield from your hand attached to Academy Researchers.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

2079-2366-5702-7288.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2079-2366-5702-7288.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Groundchuck & Dirtbag triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

967-3129-3809-6797-7087.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

1482-2034-2866-4986.description:
Cast Jeweled Lotus by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

826-907-1399-1606.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling by tapping it, causing Ley Weaver to become an Elf until end of turn.
Activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {G}{W}
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Selesnya Sanctuary.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat from step 2.

1349-6012-6798.notablePrerequisites:
There is a coin counter on any creature you control except Athreos.
You control at least one additional nontoken creature if Reluctant Role Model is the only creature you control with a coin counter on it.
1349-6012-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature with a coin counter on it.
When the creature dies, Athreos's second ability and Reluctant Role Model's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Reluctant Role Model trigger, putting a coin counter on it if it wasn't the creature that was sacrificed, or another nontoken creature you control otherwise.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2896-5145-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
When Archon of Falling Stars dies, it triggers, returning Necromancy from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Necromancy enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Necromancy to it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Repeat.

985-4740-5078-5313.manaNeeded: {2} minus {1} for each 3 life you have and minus {1} if your storm count is 2 or greater
985-4740-5078-5313.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
If needed, activate Treasonous Ogre by paying 3 life, adding {R}.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Repeat.

225-1170-2397-4124-5954.notablePrerequisites: Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
225-1170-2397-4124-5954.description:
Cast Whip Silk by paying {G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere land tokens enter the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers that many times.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping an Everywhere token.
Repeat from step 5 for the remaining trigger.
Resolve the Whip Silk spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Whip Silk by paying {G}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

914-1018-5530.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least three artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-1018-5530.description:
Cast Another Round by paying {2}{W}, blinking Dockside Extortionist and Skullwinder.
When Dockside Extortionist and Skullwinder enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Skullwinder trigger, returning Another Round from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{W}.
Repeat.
914-1018-5530.notes: If opponents control four or more artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.

2060-4772-4929-5652.description:
Activate Genku by paying {3}{W}{U}, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Doubling Season.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{U}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite {C}, you may forego removing counters from Cryptic Trilobite.

1864-2034-2757.manaNeeded: {3} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1864-2034-2757.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one basic Swamp, Mountain and Forest.
1864-2034-2757.description:
Activate a basic Swamp, Mountain and Forest by tapping them, adding {B}{R}{G}.
Cast Prossh from the command zone by paying {3}{B}{R}{G} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Prossh triggers, creating a number of 0/1 Kobolds of Kher Keep tokens equal to the amount of mana spent to cast Prossh.
Activate Earthcraft three times by tapping two Kobolds of Kher Keep tokens and Prossh, untapping a basic Swamp, Mountain and Forest.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Prossh, adding {C}{C}.
Choose to return Prossh from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Kobolds of Kher Keep token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 7 until you have enough mana to cast Prossh.
Repeat from step 1.

5330-5365-5366.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Clue.
5330-5365-5366.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing the Clue.
Jenny Flint and Lonis' second ability trigger.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on any other creature you control.
Resolve the Jenny Flint trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis' first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Atog ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2173-2292-2842-5220.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing it.
When Viscera Seer dies, Mortuary and Blood Artist trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Viscera Seer from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Viscera Seer from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

3007-4740.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Aetherflux Reservoir lifelink.
Your life total is at least 51.
You have at least one card in hand.
Toymaker does not have summoning sickness.
3007-4740.description:
Activate Toymaker by paying {1}, tapping it and discarding a card, causing Aetherflux Reservoir to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Give Aetherflux Reservoir lifelink.
Activate Aetherflux Reservoir by paying 50 life, dealing 50 damage to any target and causing you to gain 50 life.
Repeat step 3.

146-169-2773.description:
Cast Pact of the Titan choosing to pay its replicate cost an arbitrarily large number of times, paying a total of {0}.
Pact of the Titan's replicate ability triggers, causing you to copy Pact of the Titan for each time the replicate cost was paid.
Resolve the first Pact of the Titan, creating a 4/4 Giant creature token.
When the Giant enters the battlefield, Warstorm Surge triggers, dealing damage equal to the Giant's power to any target.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining Pact of the Titan.

224-1257-1525-1644.notablePrerequisites: You have a land card in hand.
224-1257-1525-1644.description:
Activate Walking Atlas by tapping it, putting a land card from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Tatyova and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Walking Atlas.
Resolve the Tatyova trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card and put it into your hand.
Repeat.

2816-3443.easyPrerequisites: Umbral Mantle attached to Deathbloom Ritualist.
2816-3443.notablePrerequisites: Deathbloom Ritualist does not have summoning sickness. You have at least three creature cards in your graveyard.
2816-3443.description:
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1558-2557-2740-4231.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Tamiyo's Journal triggers, creating two Food, two Clue, and two Treasure tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five artifacts, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

3490-3798-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
3490-3798-4050.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
The creature enters the battlefield, triggering Champion of Lambholt, putting a +1/+1 counter on Champion of Lambholt.
Animation Module triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the token, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

1987-2427-3227-4792.description:
Activate Paradise Plume by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Paradise Plume and Scrivener, blinking them as well as triggering Paradise Plume to gain you 1 life.
When Scrivener enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Paradise Plume enters the battlefield, choose "blue".
Repeat.
